title: A debt record holds the classifier's refusals of a lane's own lease push
why: docs/debts/notes.md holds three classifier-refuses-lease-push notes (Nov 3-4) plus two lane-force-push-refused notes, and #1996 adds a fourth classifier-refuses-lease-push note. Rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes: a note becomes a debt after a real incident, and no debt record exists on main (triage read, 07:52 CST Nov 8; lane revive-1042 via coordinator).
note: Done check: docs/debts/classifier-refuses-lease-push.md exists in the debt store's shape, points to decision stale-safe-force-push (which allows the push) and names step lease-push-c-and-d (PR #1316, the allow entries) as its Fix; the four notes and the two lane-force-push-refused notes are folded into it and leave notes.md. Records-only. Slug by triage. Doing in lane session_013NEJL28sozZFoz9wzHLJGb, on top of #1996 (coordinator, 07:53 CST Nov 8). Open gap (lane lease-remedy-form, #1967 round 3; coordinator 08:00 CST Nov 8): the 13:28 CST Nov 7 Own Branch Lease Push entry quotes `origin <branch>`, while lanes push `origin <src>:<branch>` (logged 06:46 CST). Unmeasured: #1316, which carries the entries, is still an open draft (read 08:00 CST Nov 8), so no lane has run under them. Measure after #1316 merges; a refusal of the `<src>:<branch>` form then goes to the page with the 13:28 grant as Based on (ruling). Sighting (coordinator 15:59 CST Nov 8): lane idle-lane-steps-unknown (session_013NEJL1VtpMs3Aw5JLtyvVD) had auto mode refuse one Bash call as Git Destructive: it chained an archive/ push with a --force-with-lease push to a branch the session had pushed (grant lease-push-c-and-d). Likely cause: the chained archive push takes the call outside the allow entry. Workaround: a new branch, #2312 replaces #1953.
